claim: For every smooth rational elliptic surface \(\pi:X\to\mathbb P^1\) over \(\mathbb C\) with a zero section and no reducible elliptic fibers, there are exactly \(135\) orbits of conic-bundle pencils under the Mordell–Weil translation group, with pencils identified up to target reparameterization. After fixing the zero section, these orbits correspond bijectively to nonzero isotropic classes in \(E_8/2E_8\) for the mod-two norm-halving quadratic form. Each conic bundle has exactly eight singular fibers, each the transverse sum of two sections.
scientific_integrity: The reduction uses Costa’s conic-class correspondence and fiber-type classification, and the classical E8 Mordell–Weil lattice. An explicit exhaustive integer certificate checks the finite lattice count only.
scientific_limitations: Requires a smooth rational elliptic surface over C with a section and no reducible elliptic fibers.
Counts conic bundles modulo fiberwise section translations, not modulo all automorphisms.
Does not address fields of definition, reducible elliptic fibers or arithmetic Galois actions.
The finite computation covers the E8 lattice count; geometry is proved symbolically from published theorems.
title: Exactly 135 translation orbits of conic bundles on a rational elliptic surface
